t.zh: 关系词有时被省掉：名词后面直接跟着另一个主语和动词。这叫<wiki-ref to="zero-relative"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The relative word is sometimes left out: the noun is followed straight away by another subject and verb. This is a <wiki-ref to="zero-relative"></wiki-ref>.

title.zh: The features we extract are invariant to rotation.
title.en: The features we extract are invariant to rotation.

body.zh: The features (that) we extract：省掉了 that。主干 The features are invariant，to rotation 挂在 invariant 上。我们提取的特征对旋转不变。
body.en: The features (that) we extract: the that is left out. The skeleton is The features are invariant, with to rotation on invariant. The features we extract do not change under rotation.

note.zh: 名词后面直接跟着“主语 + 动词”，多半是省了关系词的定语从句。
note.en: A noun followed straight away by a subject and verb is mostly a relative clause without its relative word.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: features 后面紧跟着 we extract：中间省掉了什么？
hint.en: features is followed straight away by we extract: what has been left out?

tasks.sentence: The features we extract are invariant to rotation.

we.zh: we 是被省掉 that 的从句的主语。谓语 are 说的是特征。
we.en: we is the subject of the clause whose that is left out. The verb are is about the features.

extract.zh: extract 是从句的动词：(that) we extract 说明是哪些特征。
extract.en: extract is the clause’s verb: (that) we extract says which features.
